mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, product_id, sku_id, product_name, sku_name, pv_value, bv_value, cost_amount, status, remark, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_product_pv_config (tenant_id, product_id, sku_id, product_name, sku_name, pv_value, bv_value, cost_amount, status, remark) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{productName}, #{skuName}, #{pvValue}, #{bvValue}, #{costAmount}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_product_pv_config SET product_id = #{config.productId}, sku_id = #{config.skuId}, product_name = #{config.productName}, sku_name = #{config.skuName}, pv_value = #{config.pvValue}, bv_value = #{config.bvValue}, cost_amount = #{config.costAmount}, status = #{config.status}, remark = #{config.remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{config.id}
UPDATE dms_product_pv_config SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dms_product_pv_config WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
